pages.title: Amplitude is not intensity
pages.body: Two coherent sources contribute complex phasors. Add their real and imaginary components, then compute squared magnitude. Adding intensities instead would lose the destructive interference visible as dark nodal curves.

pages.title: An experiment
pages.body: Set Phase near 3.14. Points equidistant from both sources become dark; at Phase 0 they interfere constructively. Change Wavelength and Separation to move the nodal curves. The amber dots mark the sources.

pages.title: GPU implementation and limits
pages.body: shaderPanel() supplies plane geometry and UV coordinates. The fragment shader evaluates the field per pixel, and sliders modify uniforms. Equal source amplitudes and a flat propagation domain make this a readable mathematical model rather than a full optics solver.
